title: Salle ala zainab sabr tera Zainab
body:
SALLE ALA ZAINAB SABR TERA ZAINAB
Aun-o-mohammed Ke Laashe Juhi Aaye
Sajd-e-shukrana Tune Kiya Zainab
Jano Dil-e-Zehra Tu Thi Rasan Basta
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisa Sitam Haye Tujh Pa Huwa Zainab
Zeenate Alam Ki Tujh Se Hi Zeenath Thi
Zeenate Majlis Hai Naam Tera Zainab
Nouke Sina Par Tha Sar Shahe Wala Ka
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai Ka Yun Pursa Tuj Ko Mila Zainab
Toot Gai Har Aas Ab Hai Kahan Abbas
So Gaya Karbala Main Bhai Tera Zainab
Sham Ka Wo Bazar Sham Ka Wo Darbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Lab Par Raha Tere Shukre Khuda Zainab
Sham O Kufa Ho Ya Wo Madina Ho
Dil Main Rahi Tere Karbobala Zainab
Shan Thi Kya Teri Kufe Ki Shahzadi
<<DIVIDER>>
Tera Muhafiz Tha Baba Tera Zainab
Waqt Ne Karwat Li Kaise Ghadi Aayi
Chin Gai Balwe Main Teri Rida Zainab
